Educational information

Guides provide general explanations and troubleshooting suggestions. Hardware, software, and settings vary. A guide is not a diagnosis of your device or a guarantee of a particular result. Follow the manufacturer's current instructions for your model and version.

Taking action safely

Back up important files before changes that could affect data. Read warnings before resets, installations, or hardware work. Stop and seek qualified help if a device is damaged, overheating dangerously, or outside your ability to repair safely. For managed equipment, follow your organization's support procedures.
